nodes.objective: Bring the ConPort service up via docker compose and verify REST health endpoint and SSE wrapper reachability.

Eliminate three certain runtime 500s in enhanced_server.py: fix ag_catalog schema reference, stringify UUID/Decimal in search_content JSON serialization, and resolve the SQLAlchemy session lifecycle mismatch.

Consolidate to one canonical conport codebase: add deprecation docstring to src/conport/memory_server.py, add QUARANTINE.md to services/conport_kg/, and update ARCHITECTURE.md to name docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/ as canonical.
Expose custom_data CRUD via MCP by adding get_custom_data, save_custom_data, and delete_custom_data FastMCP tools in server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py proxying the existing REST endpoints.
Expose search_content via MCP by adding a search_content FastMCP tool in server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py proxying GET /api/search/{ws}, and register it in the MCP tool schema.

Close JSON-RPC discovery gaps by adding conport_workspace_summary to dispatch_map, adding admin tool schemas for fork_instance/promote/promote_all to the MCP manifest, and verifying SSE transport parity with REST.

Remove the auto-fork write side-effect from GET /api/progress by gating it behind an explicit ?auto_fork=true query param, and update the DCP readonly facade to confirm the route is now safe for read-only agents.
Create a real integration test suite for ConPort using pytest and testcontainers, covering context CRUD, decision log/get, progress lifecycle, search, and MCP tool dispatch via a live container.

Reconcile ConPort documentation to match the real 13-tool MCP surface, create TRINITY_BOUNDS.md, add FROZEN comments to out-of-scope schema tables, and update all references from the deprecated codebases.

Give ConPort an intentional product-vs-active context model by adding a product_context column to workspace_contexts via migration 008, exposing GET/PATCH /api/product-context/{ws} REST endpoints, and adding get_product_context / update_product_context MCP tools.

Re-enable search_decisions and search_progress in the DCP read-only facade now that ConPort's underlying search and relationship surfaces are stable, and add a regression test confirming the facade passes through correctly.
Add PATCH /api/decisions/{decision_id}/outcome REST endpoint and update_decision_outcome MCP tool so agents can record retrospective outcomes on existing decisions.
Activate the review_reminders table and expose REST + MCP interfaces to create, list, and complete decision-review reminders, giving ADHD practitioners a structured way to revisit past decisions.

Activate the decision_relationships table and expose REST + MCP interfaces to create and list typed decision-to-decision links (builds_upon, supersedes, validates, caused_by) for knowledge-graph traversal.
